title: What happens if your ball falls off the tee accidentally?
question: If you accidentally knock your ball off the tee before taking your shot, what is the correct thing to do?

choices.text: Count it as a stroke and play the ball from where it comes to rest.
Simply put the ball back on the tee and play your shot with no penalty.
Add two penalty strokes for knocking the ball.
Leave the tee and ask for help.

explanation: If you accidentally make your ball fall off the tee before making a stroke, there is no penalty. You should just place the ball back on the tee and continue.
imagePrompt: A teen golfer with a driver accidentally causing the ball to fall off the tee before their shot. The golfer looks surprised, about to replace the ball.
imageAlt: A teen golfer about to replace their ball on the tee after accidentally knocking it off.
